hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Vedanta Power Limited (formerly Talwandi Sabo Power Limited) as "India's fifth-largest private sector, merchant thermal power producer with 4180 MW capacity", operating four geographically diversified thermal plants with 74% PPA tie-up and ~85% linkage coal, in its maiden quarter as a standalone listed company after a demerger effective 1 May 2026.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "Vedanta Power is India's fifth-largest private sector, merchant thermal power producer with 4180 MW capacity, operating four strategically geographically diversified located power plants: Talwandi Sabo Thermal Plant in Punjab, Meenakshi Energy Limited in Andhra Pradesh, Jharsuguda Independent Power Plant in Odisha, and Sakti Thermal Power Plant in Chhattisgarh."
- Business resilience from contracted offtake: "74% of power sales secured under long-term/medium-term PPAs such as Punjab, Odisha, 500 MW contract with Tamil Nadu and recently secured 100 MW contract with Kerala"; asset slide states "74% tie-up (3080 MW) with Punjab, Odisha & Tamil Nadu states discom".
- Fuel security as a moat: "All our assets are covered with 85% coal linkages ensuring stable cost, revenues, fuel security and insulate us from any geopolitical disturbances"; "Linkage coal secured for ~85% capacity with MCL, SECL, NCL".
- "Strategic Location — 29% of operating capacity located near coal mines."
- Industry backdrop framed as "India's low per capita power consumption – High growth potential", with India at 1460 kwh/capita (FY25 data) versus stated targets of "2000kwh by 2030" and "4000kwh by 2047".

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- "Ratings upgraded to CRISIL AA+ (CE)/AA- and ICRA AA-/A1+, reflecting improved creditworthiness" — the highlights slide instead shows "CREDIT RATING CRISIL AA- ICRA AA-, Upgraded from A+/A1 by ICRA (ratings removed from watch)"; both readings appear in the deck.
- "Maintained healthy liquidity position with Rs. 1130 Crores in cash equivalents" (consolidated Cash & Cash Eq. at 30-Jun-26).
- Net debt walk: consolidated Debt Rs 8,834 Cr and Net Debt Rs 7,704 Cr at 30-Jun-26 versus Debt Rs 8,466 Cr and Net Debt Rs 7,621 Cr at 31-Mar-26; Net Debt/EBITDA stated at 5.38x.
- "Raised Rs 300 Cr commercial paper at 8.25%."
- "disciplined financial management. We remain well positioned to support our growth pipeline and create sustainable stakeholder value" (CFO).

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Demerger] Every financial slide carries the note: "The data presented in this slide covers the full quarter commencing 1 April 2026 and is not limited to the period following the demerger, which became effective on 1 May 2026." The CEO calls it "Our maiden quarter as a standalone listed company".
- [Renaming] The signatory block identifies the issuer as "Vedanta Power Limited (formerly known as Talwandi Sabo Power Limited)"; the disclaimer still refers throughout to "Talwandi Sabo Power Limited".
- [Litigation] Jharsuguda: "Favourable judgement from APTEL tribunal for short supply matter (amount to be refunded back Rs 300 Cr). Matter sub-judice at SC" and "Favourable judgement form state commission for recovery of ash disposal cost starting Jan'22 onwards. Annual impact of Rs 40 Cr."
- [Capacity contradiction] The About section states "a total thermal power capacity of 4,780 MW" while the press release and asset slides state "4180 MW capacity" operational with 600 MW under commissioning.
- [CSR] "3.3 Lakhs+ Beneficiaries" across "4 STATES | 4 DISTRICTS | 43 VILLAGES", with named programmes Project Aarogya (5900+), Gram Nirman (11350+), Project Navi Disha (3200+), Project Sakhi (3000+) and Project Vidya (500+), all cumulative since inception.
